market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Four years before the election, individual candidate probabilities are highly speculative. With no incumbent, the 2028 Republican field will be large, and Rubio’s chances of securing the nomination are modest at best. Multiplying a ~12% nomination chance by a ~50% general election win chance gives ~6% overall, well below the market’s 14.1%. The current price likely reflects name recognition rather than fundamentals, making ‘No’ the value side.
evidence_points: Historical long-range election markets rarely price single non-incumbent candidates above 10% this far out.
Rubio lost the 2016 primary and faces potential challengers like DeSantis, Vance, Haley, and others.
No candidate has a clear structural advantage this early; true odds are diffuse.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of 2028 candidate field speculation
Historical prediction market data (e.g., 2024 GOP nomination 3 years out)
Betting odds for 2028 US President from Polymarket analogies
